messages.subject: Project Yarrow — engagement and next steps
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Helena,

Good to speak yesterday. Please find our engagement letter for Project Yarrow attached for signature. As discussed, James Osei will run the day-to-day and Elena Marchetti will support.

Our immediate priorities are (i) reviewing the mutual NDA and heads of terms you have already agreed with Caldera, and (ii) preparing a first draft of the long-term supply agreement once we have the qualification baseline. Happy to set up a kick-off call this week.

Kind regards,
Sarah

--
Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
